opening.label: Flat to marginally mixed start
opening.headline: Flat to marginally mixed start: Wall Street weak, Asia negative, crude easing
drivers: GIFT Nifty 25,351.0 (+1 pts, +0.01% vs Nifty's last close).
Asia this morning: Nikkei -5.06%, Hang Seng -0.12%, Kospi -3.31%.
Currency, crude and volatility: Brent 89.22 (-3.62%); USD/INR 92.910 (-0.41%); India VIX 17.70 (+2.18%).

story: Nifty 50 opened at 25,929, a gap-up of 0.50% from the previous close of 25,801.
The index dipped to a low of 25,344 (-1.77%) around 3:10 PM and touched a high of 25,992 (+0.74%) around 9:15 AM.
It settled at 25,350 (-1.75%), near the bottom of the day's range, so sellers stayed in charge into the close.
12 of the 50 Nifty stocks advanced and 37 declined; Bank Nifty lagged (-3.17%).
Latest institutional data (19 Nov): FII/FPI net +7411 Cr, DII net -1357 Cr.
risks: Markets stay shut until Wednesday (2 days): weekend news, geopolitics and any Wall Street or Asian moves will all be priced in at the open.
Wall Street trades through tonight (from about 7:00 PM IST); the S&P 500 last closed at 6,910.39 (-3.70%), so US data and Fed commentary can swing the opening.
Brent crude is at US$89.22 (-3.62%); a sharp fall would help oil marketers and the rupee.
Currency and yields to track: USD/INR 92.910 (-0.41%), US 10-year yield 4.91% (-2.77%). A firmer dollar or higher US yields usually weigh on foreign flows.
GIFT Nifty keeps trading into the late evening, now 25,351.0 (+0.01% vs Nifty's close): the best live read on the next opening.
